hypothesised_pattern: The base model over-predicts class_2 when x1 is positive and x2 is negative, a region where the true class is class_0 or class_1 and the sign of x5 appears to decide between them (x5 > 0 gives class_0, x5 < 0 gives class_1).
rationale: All four true-non-class_2 errors here (x1 from 0.71 to 2.06, x2 from -0.70 to -2.83) were predicted class_2, and the two similar errors in the previous batch share the same signs, which points to a negative x1*x2 effect on class_2. Within this group the true class_0 rows all have x5 > 0 and the true class_1 rows both have x5 < 0, though that split rests on only six rows.
